ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There is a legend on the right side of the figure, marking expressway, main roads, rivers, lakes, and the functional zone symbols numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4. After locating the land-use symbol corresponding to number 3 according to the legend, it can be seen that this type of land is distributed in relatively large areas and in continuous patches inside the city, mainly spreading around internal urban roads, with rivers, lakes, and green-space buffer conditions nearby; it is not located at the most core position where traffic arteries intersect, nor is it concentrated on the urban edge or near traffic exits like industrial land. Reasoning: In ecological city planning, residential zones are suitable to be arranged in areas with a relatively good environment and less pollution, while also having a certain degree of transportation convenience. The spatial distribution characteristics of functional zone 3 in the figure meet the layout requirements for residential zones. Therefore, functional zone 3 should be planned as a residential zone.
